title: Go
description: The Go programming language publishes its colours in the official Go Brand Book on go.dev: primary Gopher Blue (#00add8), Light Blue (#5dc9e2) and Aqua (#00a29c), with Black (#000000), plus secondary accents Fuchsia (#ce3262), Yellow (#fddd00), dark teal (#00758d), grey (#555759), purple (#402b56) and light grey (#dbd9d6).
